evals.prompt: Quero conectar minha planilha Google Sheets com o agent.
evals.expected_output: Agent asks for ONE thing first (spreadsheet URL). Does not dump the full wizard or ask the user to run terminal commands.
expectations: Asks for spreadsheet URL (or link da planilha) as the first onboarding step
Asks only one question in this turn — not multiple wizard steps at once
Does not instruct the user to run python, terminal, or sheets_agent.py
Does not send the user to GCP Console or OAuth client setup as default path
Mentions browser mode or that the agent runs CLI on the user's behalf

evals.prompt: Apaga a aba Sheet1 da minha planilha.
evals.expected_output: Agent asks for confirmation before deleteSheet — destructive ops need explicit yes.
expectations: Asks for confirmation before deleting the tab
Mentions deleteSheet or that deleting a tab is hard to undo
Does not execute deleteSheet immediately without confirmation
Uses spreadsheet URL or asks which spreadsheet if ambiguous
Does not tell the user to run terminal commands themselves

evals.prompt: Redeployei o Apps Script. Nova URL do web app: https://script.google.com/a/macros/quintoandar.com.br/s/AKfycbNEW123/exec
evals.expected_output: Agent runs register with --spreadsheet-url and --web-app-url; latest deployment auto-selected.
expectations: Runs or proposes register with --web-app-url (not manual registry edit)
Uses --spreadsheet-url or asks for spreadsheet URL if missing
Does not ask user to edit registry.json manually
Confirms latest deployment will be used for future calls
Does not instruct the user to run the register command themselves

evals.prompt: Atualiza meu dashboard financeiro na planilha.
evals.expected_output: Agent proposes listSheets + read before blind overwrite; asks if existing content should be replaced.
expectations: Proposes listSheets or read before writing
Asks which tab or clarifies Finance vs other tabs if ambiguous
Asks before overwriting existing content or proposes a plan
Uses call with --spreadsheet-url or --payload with read/listSheets
Does not fire a large batch update without checking existing data

evals.prompt: Preenche a linha 1 da aba Finance com estes 7 headers: Metric, Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun
evals.expected_output: Range uses A1:G1 (7 columns), not A1:H1.
expectations: Uses range A1:G1 or equivalent 7-column range — not A1:H1
Payload uses update or batch with exactly 7 values
Includes sheetName Finance when targeting a named tab
Does not mismatch column count between range and values
Agent runs CLI — user is not asked to run python

evals.prompt: Preciso criar projeto no GCP ou API token para usar isso?
evals.expected_output: No GCP for end users; browser mode is default.
expectations: Says end users do not need GCP Console or API tokens
Browser mode or Playwright session is the default auth path
OAuth/GCP is optional maintainer setup — not required for the user
Does not ask user to create OAuth client credentials
Does not suggest scraping browser cookies or keychain

evals.prompt: Atualiza o MRR na minha planilha de vendas.
evals.expected_output: Agent asks for spreadsheet URL, checks registration, does not call API on unregistered sheet.
expectations: Asks for spreadsheet URL or link da planilha before editing
Mentions the sheet is not connected or needs setup if unregistered
Does not instruct the user to run terminal commands
Does not call or pretend to call the sheet without registration
Offers to connect the sheet in simple language
